name: Kick stage
description: A small extra stage for a second try at leaving Earth orbit.
troubleDescription: The upper stage shut down early, leaving the spacecraft on a path that will never reach Mars. The kick stage could be fired to make up the difference.
rescueDescription: The kick stage fired and put the spacecraft back on its way to Mars, using up fuel meant for later.

name: Reserve fuel
description: Extra fuel for a second try at the burn into Mars orbit.
troubleDescription: The engine cut out early, and the spacecraft is about to fly past Mars. The reserve fuel could be used for a second burn.
rescueDescription: The second burn on the reserve fuel caught the spacecraft, and it is in orbit around Mars, but its tanks are nearly dry.

name: Retro thrusters
description: Extra thrusters for a last try at slowing down above the ground.
troubleDescription: {lander} came in too fast over {site}. The retro thrusters could be fired for a last try at slowing down.
rescueDescription: {lander} made a hard landing at {site}, shaken but working.

name: Backup engine
description: A second engine on the Earth return stage, for another try at leaving Mars orbit.
troubleDescription: The engine of {stage} has failed in Mars orbit. The backup engine could be lit for another try at the burn home.
rescueDescription: The backup engine fired and sent {aboard} on the way home.

name: Ascent engine restart
description: A restart system for the ascent engine, for another try at climbing into Mars orbit.
troubleDescription: The ascent engine has shut down early, leaving {aboard} short of Mars orbit. It could be restarted for another try.
rescueDescription: The ascent engine relit and lifted {aboard} into Mars orbit at the second try.

name: Manual docking
description: A backup docking system that can be steered by hand, by the Crew aboard or from Earth, for another try at docking in Mars orbit.
troubleDescription: The automatic docking with {stage} has failed. The ascent craft could be steered in by hand for another try.
rescueDescription: The ascent craft docked with {stage} at the second attempt, steered in by hand.

name: Backup parachutes
description: A second set of parachutes for the capsule, for a last chance at a safe splashdown.
troubleDescription: The capsule's main parachutes didn't open as it came down through Earth's atmosphere. The backup parachutes could still be deployed.
rescueDescription: The backup parachutes opened late, and the capsule hit the sea hard with {aboard} inside.
